rv.q: This production was very well done considering the size of the theater and no orchestra.
An exciting, expertly crafted and creatively directed production, “Little Shop of Horrors” is sure to be remembered and talked about for years to come.
For current and future fans of this cult classic, Citadel’s production of “Little Shop” is truly a treat.
Citadel Theatre’s season-opener musical about the plant that everyone loves to hate delivers a knockout punch for an entertaining evening or afternoon.
Director Matthew Silar, production manager Ellen Phelps and scenic designer Eric Luchen have magically figured out how to innovatively cram scenery... into Citadel's miniscule space.
